head: codex/5695-pr-state-mergeability
title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][tooling] Preserve blocked and unstable PR mergeability states (#5695)
body:
Closes #5695

Preserves GitHub mergeability distinctions in csdlc-pr-state: only behind is stale_base, dirty is conflicted, blocked/unstable/draft/unknown remain waiting, and HasHooks normalizes to the clean merge target accepted by csdlc-merge. Adds focused classification and merge-gate regression tests.

Validation: cargo fmt --check; cargo test -p csdlc-v2 github::tests; cargo test -p csdlc-v2 merge::tests; cargo clippy -p csdlc-v2 --lib -- -D warnings; git diff --check. Exact-head subagent review completed with no actionable findings.
